gold.agent_sql: SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE   film_id IN (     SELECT       film_id     FROM film_category   ) LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM actor LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM customer LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(DISTINCT name) FROM language LIMIT 100
SELECT   title FROM film WHERE   length > 180 LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE   rating = 'R' LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE   rental_rate > 4 LIMIT 100
SELECT   first_name,   last_name FROM customer WHERE   last_name LIKE 'B%' LIMIT 100
SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE   length BETWEEN 60 AND 90 LIMIT 100
SELECT   CAST(SUM(length) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) FROM film LIMIT 100
SELECT   SUM(amount) FROM payment LIMIT 100
SELECT   MAX(rental_rate) AS max_rental_rate,   MIN(rental_rate) AS min_rental_rate FROM film LIMIT 100
SELECT   c.name,   COUNT(fc.film_id) FROM category AS c LEFT JOIN film_category AS fc   ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY   c.category_id,   c.name LIMIT 100
SELECT   s.store_id,   COUNT(c.customer_id) FROM store AS s LEFT JOIN customer AS c   ON s.store_id = c.store_id GROUP BY   s.store_id LIMIT 100
SELECT   title,   length FROM film ORDER BY   length DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT   a.first_name,   a.last_name,   COUNT(fa.film_id) AS broj_filmova FROM actor AS a JOIN film_actor AS fa   ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id GROUP BY   a.first_name,   a.last_name ORDER BY   broj_filmova DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT   c.name,   COUNT(fc.film_id) AS broj_filmova FROM category AS c LEFT JOIN film_category AS fc   ON c.category_id = fc.category_id GROUP BY   c.name ORDER BY   broj_filmova DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT   c.first_name,   c.last_name,   SUM(p.amount) AS ukupan_iznos FROM customer AS c JOIN payment AS p   ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id GROUP BY   c.first_name,   c.last_name ORDER BY   ukupan_iznos DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT   c.country,   COUNT(c2.country_id) AS broj_kupaca FROM country AS c JOIN city AS ci   ON c.country_id = ci.country_id JOIN address AS a   ON ci.city_id = a.city_id JOIN customer AS cu   ON a.address_id = cu.address_id JOIN country AS c2   ON ci.country_id = c2.country_id GROUP BY   c.country ORDER BY   broj_kupaca DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT   c.first_name,   c.last_name,   COUNT(r.rental_id) AS broj_iznajmljivanja FROM customer AS c JOIN rental AS r   ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id GROUP BY   c.first_name,   c.last_name ORDER BY   broj_iznajmljivanja DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT   f.title FROM film AS f JOIN film_actor AS fa   ON f.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor AS a   ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id WHERE   a.first_name = 'NICK' AND a.last_name = 'WAHLBERG' LIMIT 100
SELECT   f.title,   c.name FROM film AS f JOIN film_category AS fc   ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category AS c   ON fc.category_id = c.category_id ORDER BY   f.title ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT   s.store_id,   COUNT(i.inventory_id) FROM store AS s LEFT JOIN inventory AS i   ON s.store_id = i.store_id GROUP BY   s.store_id LIMIT 100

SELECT   COUNT(*) FROM film WHERE   film_id IN (     SELECT       film_id     FROM film_category     WHERE       category_id IN (         SELECT           category_id         FROM category         WHERE           name = 'Comedy'       )   ) LIMIT 100
